name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, ui domain, descriptor (recruitment screen repaint tick latch) accurately states purpose and reflects the data kind (a tick latch / state var). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own/any data address). 'recruitment' is a screen name, not an ID, so nothing to preserve/strip.
purpose: BIOS-tick latch that throttles the recruitment select screen's repaint to at most once per BIOS tick.
logic_summary: Holds the BIOS midnight tick counter (word @ 0x40:0x6C, sign-extended) captured the last time the recruitment select screen was redrawn. In fd2_wait_input_with_recruitment_repaint's wait-for-key loop: each iteration reads the latch; if the current BIOS tick differs it stores the new tick into the latch, re-renders the recruitment screen, and memmoves the composed frame to 0xA0000 (mode-13h); otherwise it skips the repaint. Zero-init in BSS, so the first loop entry reads 0 and (unless the BIOS tick is also 0) forces an immediate repaint + latch.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar holding the last-rendered BIOS tick value (low word of 0:046C, sign-extended to 32 bits via MOVSX). Accessed only as a dword at both sites (CMP EAX,[0x54127] / MOV [0x54127],EAX).
notes: Two xrefs only: READ @0x32033, WRITE @0x32043, both inside fd2_wait_input_with_recruitment_repaint (entry 0x32004). Game-side write => not const => emit zero-bss (caller_pool=fd2 subsystem=ui data_kind=state_var emit_action=emit_c_const_zero). src comment block (input.c lines 784-802) verified accurate against decompile + disassembly; kept as-is. Ghidra plate content lived in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field (PLATE_COMMENT was null); migrated a refined, src-consistent version into PLATE_COMMENT and cleared PRE_COMMENT per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism (set_plate_via_java_api). No src edit, so no clobber risk on input.c.
